settings.title: FAQ
settings.intro: Everything about the drop, your order and your tee.
settings.contact_text: Still got a question? We answer every message.

settings.question: How does the AURA Tee fit?
settings.answer: It's a boxy, oversized cut with dropped shoulders and a cropped length — exactly what you see on the crew in the photos. Want it closer to the body? Take one size down.

settings.question: What's the difference between the five colors?
settings.answer: The tee itself is white in every version. The color is the aura printed around the AS monogram on the front and back: Yellow, Blue, Red, Pink or Orange.

settings.question: Will a color come back once it's sold out?
settings.answer: Drops are made in limited quantities. Join the list at the bottom of the page and you'll be the first to know if anything comes back.

settings.question: Where do you ship?
settings.answer:
Belgium: from €6.90, free from €70. Express from €11.
France, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Germany: from €9.90, free from €120.
Rest of Europe (incl. UK, Switzerland, Norway): from €12.90.
Worldwide (US, Canada, Japan, Australia and more): from €19.90.

The exact price depends on the weight of your order and is shown at checkout. Orders ship from Belgium.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange?
settings.answer: Yes. You have 14 days after delivery to change your mind. Email us with your order number, then send the items back unworn and unwashed with their tags. Return shipping is on you unless the item is faulty. Full details in our refund policy (link in the footer).

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: All payment methods available for your country are shown at checkout. Payments are processed securely by Shopify.

settings.question: How should I wash it?
settings.answer: To keep the print sharp: wash inside out, cold, and skip the tumble dryer. Don't iron directly on the print.
